zh.text: 「我创建的」里改**分类**或**显示名**现在**立刻生效** —— 以前列表会把市场索引里的旧值盖在本地清单之上，得等重新上架、索引重建之后才更新（`version` 一直是对的，分类与名字漏了）。
发布上架时，**分类 / 标签 / 重启需求**改为以**本地清单**为准 —— 以前发布载荷里不带这三样，于是索引分片里落的分类是默认值「玩法」、标签是空的、重启需求恒为「需要重启」。

en.text: Changing a mod's **category** or **display name** under "created by me" now takes effect **immediately** - the list used to merge the market snapshot over the local manifest, so the old value persisted until the mod was re-published and the index rebuilt (`version` was already correct; category and name were not).

When publishing, **category / tags / requires-restart** now come from the **local manifest** - the publish payload never carried them, so the index shard recorded the default category "玩法", empty tags, and "needs restart" for every mod.
